purpose: Static S-001 source-effect evidence attached to the sole controlling remediation tracker. Not an executable harness input, runtime assertion, performance result or separate plan.
review_limits: Syntax inventory aids source review; it does not prove dynamic state independence.
Whole-module import closure includes helpers used only by isolated/measurement cases. Their presence does not authorize sharing.
Reporting ownership never grants execution isolation. Existing isolated and measurement declarations remain unchanged.
Runtime alone/order/concurrency and failure validation remains required.

boundaries.actor: fixtures.ts creates a fresh test identity and credentials, fresh browser context and actor request; sessions are revoked and verified at teardown. The provisioner mutates explicit owned user IDs only.
boundaries.incident: Creation returns the incident ID threaded through row/query/member/view/lifecycle/history/entity operations. ListVisibleIncidents joins membership by authenticated user ID; the deployment-admin flag does not widen that listing.
boundaries.preferences: Account endpoints bind the current actor; workbook preferences bind own incident and actor. Visual preference mocks use a WeakMap keyed by Page.
boundaries.browser: Routes, clocks, DOM, local storage, clipboard state and observations belong to a fresh Page/BrowserContext. Additional collaboration users are tracked and contexts closed in finally blocks.
boundaries.background: Evidence upload/verification tracks exact object/job/record IDs; socket monitors filter the owned incident. Pending intercepted operations settle or fail the cohort; failures quarantine reuse.
boundaries.process_state: Application/font/preference/query caches are WeakMaps keyed by Page. Timeline visual investigation Map is verified then cleared in finally by afterEach. Schema/recipe registries are read-only inputs.
boundaries.publication: Contrast outputs use the exact selected title/context under the current group directory; unprefixed selected-title slugs have no collisions in current compatibility partitions. Visual capture identities remain exact; update writes retain exclusive admission. Worker private state and cleanup markers belong to one cohort.
boundaries.stronger_boundaries: Global clock/fault controls, deployment-wide administrator/listing assertions, frontend rebuild/lifecycle and measurements remain isolated/dedicated. network_flow_claimed retains distinct runtime and affinity.
